subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI save-time `MEMORY.md` budget enforcement now, and should auto-archive be in scope or folded into the broader bounded-memory design?
rationale: Current main already warns and diagnoses truncation, but the remaining request changes the workspace-file editor UX and persistent memory lifecycle rather than repairing one clearly broken code path.

options.title: Define narrow Control UI guard
options.body: Add budget display and explicit save-time warning or refusal for bootstrap-owned files, leaving archive behavior to a separate memory lifecycle decision.

options.title: Fold into bounded memory work
options.body: Track hard limits and archive behavior under the broader bounded-memory issue and keep this issue focused on diagnostics and editor visibility.

options.title: Adopt diagnostics-only PR scope
options.body: Review the open diagnostics PR for `/status` or edit-error hints, but do not treat it as closing the requested Control UI save enforcement.

recommendation.title: Define narrow Control UI guard
recommendation.body: Add budget display and explicit save-time warning or refusal for bootstrap-owned files, leaving archive behavior to a separate memory lifecycle decision.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting product decision across Control UI, memory lifecycle, and bootstrap budget semantics, and this account is the strongest available product-routing signal in the checked policy/history.
